## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and for whom.

## Change

What this pull request does. Keep it to one purposeful change.

## Evidence

Tests run, and any metric with its baseline. Calibration claims must come from a
held-out split. If you trained anything, report the command, the seed and the
data split.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior has a test, including the failure mode
- [ ] No personal data, credentials or uncertain-license content added
- [ ] No artifacts uploaded to PyPI or Hugging Face

## Not done

Any part of the intended scope left out, and why.
